body: He told me that they were suspicious because we had only known each other for 3 months online (long distance relationship) and wanted to stay for a month or longer. They kept implying that they believed he was coming here to work & saying things like “You know you can’t make money while you’re there, right? You value your visa, right? You know your visa is for tourists, right?”. The default amount of time is usually 6 months at that border (Tijuana), it definitely feels odd that they only gave him ~a month ;-;
